skills: Recognize confusion, tachycardia, discomfort, minimal urine output and positive urinalysis as abnormal findings
Report abnormal findings to provider using SBAR
Obtain sterile urine sample for culture
Access and document care in the EHR

presentation.summary: Older adult with polypharmacy-related dehydration and urinary retention is admitted for monitoring, rehydration, and IV antibiotics. Patient experiences acute confusion related to a urinary tract infection.

primaryChallenge: Learner assesses and implements care for an older adult patient experiencing acute confusion related to a urinary tract infection.
